corpus_name: Mundus Ulterior Phase 1 Part 2 — Seed Corpus
milestone_target: ~25-30 documents, 3-5 per region, spanning all 7 regions
schema_note: Each document JSON carries: id, region, title, source_type, language_code, language_note, date, findspot (where applicable), original_text_excerpt, original_text_note, reference_translation, translation_source, citation, citation_original (where available), notes. Phase 2 W1 adds two optional place blocks, findspot_places and subject_places — shape, vocabulary and conditional requirements are specified in PLACES.md and enforced by ingest/places.py; coordinates are never written into a record, only pleiades_id, which ingest/gazetteer.py resolves against a dated cached snapshot.
follow_up_before_ingestion: Several records (Palmyrene Tariff, Weilue, Hou Hanshu, Akananuru 149, Ezana Stone) have original_text_excerpt fields that are paraphrased or partial — pull verbatim transliterations from the cited critical editions before chunking/embedding in Part 3.
Confirm long-term link stability for non-museum citations (Wikipedia, academic PDFs) and consider archiving snapshots (e.g. via the Wayback Machine) for provenance permanence.

Sabaic Jabal Dabub inscription (arabia-04) is 6th century and not directly Rome-linked; consider swapping or supplementing with a denser Himyarite/Roman-contact Sabaic text if Arabia needs stronger Roman-contact anchoring.
